entries.00daa56551cb77da: Nissui Corporation is the core of a group whose main businesses are the Marine Business, the Food Business, the Fine Business and the Logistics Business. The group consists of the company, 71 [[term:subsidiary|subsidiaries]] and 27 [[term:affiliate|affiliates]], and also provides research and services related to each business. Its mission is to solve social issues through pursuing new possibilities for 'food' in response to changes in the times and environment, and it states that it will make use of its resource access capabilities, research and development capabilities, production technology and quality assurance capabilities built up over more than 110 years, together with a value chain made up of Global Links and Local Links spread across countries around the world. Consolidated headcount as of March 31, 2026 was 11,526.
entries.0577702a4106e40a: This business manufactures and sells chilled foods such as boxed meals and prepared dishes. Sales promotion effects at convenience stores were significant, and sales of boxed meals and prepared dishes remained strong following the previous year, resulting in higher revenue. Manufacturing facilities for chilled foods are located at the Isesaki, Yachiyo, Itami and Gunma plants of Nihon Derika Sabisu Co., Ltd. (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.10c5214bcd661d61: Toward achieving its long-term vision 'GOOD FOODS 2030,' the medium-term management plan 'GOOD FOODS Recipe2,' launched in April 2025, sets out as its basic strategies the deepening of business portfolio management, the acceleration of global expansion (expanding business scale mainly in North America and Europe and developing a second pillar alongside marine fry products), and the development of new businesses and business boundary areas.
entries.1b78c59f4f7e83e8: This business catches fish, raises fish, and processes and sells them. It comprises three businesses: the Fishing Business, the Aquaculture Business, and the Processing and Trading Business. Consolidated subsidiaries include Kurose Suisan Co., Ltd. and NISSUI USA, INC., and affiliates include Daisui Co., Ltd., among others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥380,151 million (up 4.4% year on year), the second largest after the Food Business.

entries.2db72c0625188cfc: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥931,265 million, an increase of ¥45,139 million from the previous year (105.1% of the prior year). Revenue from external customers by business was ¥500,985 million for the Food Business, ¥380,151 million for the Marine Business, ¥16,982 million for the Fine Business, ¥16,615 million for the Logistics Business and ¥16,531 million for other operations not included in reportable segments. Year-on-year ratios were 106.4% for the Food Business, 104.4% for the Marine Business, 107.2% for the Fine Business, 100.5% for the Logistics Business and 88.7% for other operations. The Food Business is the largest, followed by the Marine Business.

entries.41718e4b0293ba89: This business processes and sells marine products. In Japan, the business recovered from the third quarter owing to increased sales volume of fish oil and the effect of price revisions for salmon and trout, but the effects of the first half remained, and for the full year revenue increased. In North America, the processing business increased the share of Alaska pollock fillet production, and selling prices for surimi also rose. In the trading business, sales of Pacific cod, salmon and trout, and crab were firm, and overall revenue increased. In Europe, sales in Italy, the Benelux countries and the United Kingdom were firm, and revenue increased.
entries.42a09f762bbca646: SCI Co., Ltd. (major customer of the Food Business; 13.2% of consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026)
entries.44e4e55f8c279594: The company's offerings are divided into four [[term:segment|reportable segments]]. The Marine Business consists of the fishing business, which catches fish using boats, the aquaculture business, which raises fish, and the processing and trading business, which processes and sells marine products, and it handles the catching of yellowtail, horse mackerel and mackerel, the farming of bluefin tuna and silver salmon, the sale of Alaska pollock fillets and surimi, and the sale of cod, salmon and trout, and crab. The Food Business consists of the processing business, which makes frozen foods for household and business use as well as chikuwa and fish sausage, and the chilled business, which makes boxed meals and prepared dishes. The Fine Business consists of functional ingredients such as EPA and DHA, used as materials in pharmaceutical raw materials, supplement ingredients and infant powdered milk, and functional foods such as the mail-order functional food with function claims 'Goma Tonyu Shitate no Minna no Mikata DHA' and the Foods for Specified Health Uses 'Imāku S'. The Logistics Business handles refrigerated warehousing, delivery and customs clearance. Other operations not included in the reportable segments include shipbuilding and ship repair, ship operation, engineering and other services.
entries.53b5135fcf6cc5fe: [[term:net-income-attributable-to-owners-of-parent|Net income attributable to owners of the parent]] for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥27,517 million, an increase of ¥2,136 million from the previous year (108.4% of the prior year). Revenue and profit at each stage both reached record highs. The company explains that improvement progressed in the fishing and aquaculture business and the North American marine processing business, which had struggled in the previous year, and that the chilled business performed steadily.

entries.905995615982480d: This business manufactures and sells pharmaceutical ingredients, raw materials for dietary supplements, and health foods. The company and one consolidated subsidiary carry out this business. Functional ingredients are EPA, DHA and similar materials used as raw materials for supplements and as additives to infant formula. Functional foods are mainly foods with function claims sold by mail order, such as “Goma Tonyu Shitate no Minna no Mikata DHA,” and foods for specified health uses, such as “Imaku S.” Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,982 million (up 7.2% year on year), with sales of pharmaceutical ingredients and domestic sales of functional ingredients for supplements being firm.

In South America, sales volume of coho salmon increased, sales to North America were strengthened, the share of value-added products with a higher degree of processing rose, and selling prices also rose, resulting in higher revenue. entries.db0ff93253b60b01: This business manufactures and sells frozen foods, marine paste products such as chikuwa and fish sausage, and chilled foods such as boxed lunches and side dishes. It consists of two businesses: the processed foods business and the chilled foods business. Consolidated subsidiaries include Nihon Delica Service Co., Ltd. and GORTON'S, INC., among others. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥500,985 million (up 6.4% year on year), the largest business in the group. The major customer is SCI Co., Ltd., and sales to this customer were ¥123,180 million, or 13.2% of consolidated net sales.
